systems.system: Digital Master Plan for decentralized entities
systems.owner: Ministry of Decentralisation and Local Development; being updated in mid-2025, per the minister's address to the National Assembly
systems.tiers: 394 decentralized local authorities: 10 regions, 360 local councils and 14 city councils; aims named are interoperability between systems, budget tracking, digitised human resource management and digital civil registration

systems.system: National School of Local Administration digital curricula
systems.tiers: training of local administration staff; modules on digital government planned

note: The plan under update is described by interoperability and services, with no mention of connecting local authority offices; the article gives the count of 360 local councils and 14 city councils.
